title: A managed form: arrange fields and rows while preserving data
goal: Create an explicit document form in a copy, display the header and Работы, and verify input usability without changing older values.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a 4; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: From a familiar situation to a checkable question
paragraphs: An attractive field on screen does not itself store data. Follow its path to Объект and test the form by reopening the same number. The new task changes one comment; header and rows are neighbouring controls that must remain intact.

sections.title: Where to act
paragraphs: The previous ReportsV 2 fixture stores request headers but has neither Работы nor a custom explicit form. In a prepared separate copy add the table and form only through the lesson steps below. Preserve the A 4 customer note and old documents. The example and new work use different own sets; do not substitute a whole-database total for two particular numbers. Nexus stores the explanation and note; perform the actions in installed1C.

sections.title: A form supports a workflow
paragraphs: Place customer, service and duration in input order. Labels must state units; required fields should be identifiable without color alone. Save must communicate its outcome. A starter form does not need dozens of buttons: tie every action to an operator task and a verifiable state.

A form is a window for viewing/editing an object, not an independent database. An automatic form is derived from metadata; an explicit managed form lets the developer select layout and elements. An element must bind to Объект data: a decorative text field without a data path does not persist a document attribute.

sections.title: How to carry out the worked example
paragraphs: Follow the route in your prepared own copy. This is the worked example; the new task below uses different data. Compare each expectation with your actual reread.
Step 1. Record number/date/references/duration of an older request and the new 20/10 document. Close Enterprise, keeping this copy’s Designer. Expected: Two control documents identified.

Step 2. Choose Document form named УчебнаяФормаЗаявки. Select Клиент, Услуга, ДлительностьМинут, Статус, Комментарий and Работы with its fields. Verify the main attribute Объект. Expected: A separate managed form has data-bound elements.

Step 3. Place required fields above the comment and Работы below the header. Keep standard commands. Assign УчебнаяФормаЗаявки as main object form only in this copy. Expected: Required fields and commands are present.
Step 4. Review changes, update the copy and open your newer control document. Check header, Работы and standard commands. Expected: Assigned form opens with persisted rows.

Step 5. Traverse fields with Tab. Change only the newer document comment to Форма A5 проверена, save and reopen. Compare header/rows. Open the older document without edits and compare its recorded controls. Expected: New comment persists; earlier fields and rows remain intact.

sections.title: A form element differs from a data attribute
paragraphs: An input displays an attribute but does not itself create persistent storage. An unbound control can lose entered values. Trace control → formattribute → object. Relabeling must preserve links to stored data. Appearance is not a substitute for choosing the business data type.

Работы already exists in the previous lesson’s copy. Add a document form under Forms, select header fields and the table in the wizard, and assign the main object form. If an existing custom form is present, inspect and preserve it first; create a separately named teaching form in the copy instead of overwriting someone else’s development.

sections.title: Predict the result
paragraphs: A form displays the label “55 minutes”. Does that establish that the document stores 55?

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. It might be an arbitrary caption. A field needs its object data path, followed by save, close and reread of the same number. Rearranging fields must not alter the value itself.

sections.title: An error should guide correction
paragraphs: For negative minutes, name the field and allowed range while preserving other inputs. Do not clear the form or create a new document just to retry. A keyboard user must locate the error and return to Save. A rejected command must not show a false success message.

Place required fields before the optional comment, with rows below. Clear ordering reduces omissions but does not replace validation. Keep required fields visible and do not enable privileged mode. This lesson uses standard save commands; custom commands and client/server handlers belong to the programming course.

sections.title: Check the explanation’s boundary
paragraphs: Use the second worked case only in an own copy or unsaved draft. Preserve the accepted record and explain the discrepancy.
Inspect its data path and reread the actual object field.

sections.title: Usability is checked through actions
paragraphs: Use Tab, select a reference, enter duration, save and reopen without a mouse. Check a long service name and narrow window. A responsive Nexus page does not prove the 1C desktop client works on a phone: record the actual client and device. Screenshots supplement the workflow protocol rather than replacing execution.

Test an older document with empty new rows and the newer 20/10 document. Reopen, compare and reread. Rearranging elements alone must not change number, date, references or duration. Edits in an open form remain a draft until a save command: distinguish discarding unsaved changes from Save and close.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: In your copy preserve the form source and check your 55/40+15 request’s paths Объект.Клиент, Объект.Услуга, Объект.ДлительностьМинут and Объект.Работы. Open its managed form, change only the comment to “Форма самостоятельной работы A 5”, save and reopen. Compare number, date, references, 55 and both 40/15 rows. Separately open an old request with empty new rows without changing it. Traverse available fields with Tab and record the actual observation; do not claim untested devices passed.
Record a prediction first. After your own attempt reveal the reference and compare the selected record as well as its number.

sections.title: Actual training-service window
paragraphs: Two newly restored copies in actual1C verify references after renaming, row persistence, absence of automatic recalculation, empty-header refusal, the actual named form and fresh reads. Main 9/255 and independent 9/290 include earlier 4/120. All old fields and the A 4 note persist. Two GUI captures show only their labelled forms. Manual wizard, full Tab, permissions, installer, devices and learner understanding are NOT RUN.
